issues.root_cause: apps/web/app/design/step-6/page.tsx likely has hardcoded 'STEP 4 OF 4' instead of the correct step number, or the step configuration maps step-6 to step 4.

issues.description: Multiple React hydration errors: 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' and 'entire root will switch to client rendering'. This indicates dynamic content (e.g. dates, random values, or QR code data) differs between SSR and client.
issues.root_cause: apps/web/app/design/step-6/page.tsx likely renders something dynamic (e.g. QR code URL with timestamp, Math.random(), or Date) during SSR that differs on the client.
